title: Collapse with no pulse
summary: A soldier went down after a blast wave hit him in the chest. He does not respond, is not breathing and you cannot feel a pulse. You carry an AED, a pocket BVM and a pulse oximeter. Keep him going until the medic arrives.
objectives: Recognise cardiac arrest: no response, no breathing, no carotid pulse
Start CPR at once and keep it going: every pause stops the restart chances
AED: pads on, stop compressions to analyze, shock when advised, straight back to CPR
Never shock a patient who has a pulse
When the pulse returns: check and clear the airway, then ventilate with the pocket BVM until SpO2 recovers
